select * from ins_dict_models

where mark_id = :mark_id

datasets.name: ODSBanks
datasets.sql:
select * from bankm
order by name

datasets.name: ODSCusts
datasets.sql:
select * from (
SELECT a.id,a.insured_typeid,a.surname || ' ' ||a.name || ' ' ||a.fathername name, a.ADDRESS
  FROM ins_customers a where a.close_prefix=0
  order by a.surname

)

datasets.name: ODSMotorkasko
datasets.sql:
select mk.rowid, mk.* from ins_motorkasco mk 
where mk.cid = :cid

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid,ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.id = :cid

datasets.name: ODSdrAccessPeople
datasets.sql:
select id.rowid, id.* from ins_draccesspeople id
where id = :id

datasets.name: ODSSex
datasets.sql:
select 1 as id , 'Kişi' as name from dual
union all
select 0 as id , 'Qadın' as name from dual

datasets.name: ODSMonths
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_tarif_months

where release_id = :release_id

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state_id)

datasets.name: ODSFranshiz
datasets.sql:
select itf.id,itf.ammount as franshiz,itf.month_id, it.ammount as tariff
  from ins_tarif_franshiz itf, ins_tariffs it
where itf.month_id = :month_id
and 
  it.franshiz_id = itf.id
order by itf.ammount

datasets.name: ODSReport
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME,
       ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME2,
       ic.address insuredaddress,ic.mobilephone,ic.homephone,insuredtype, insuredcolor as inscolor,insuredcolor||' ,'||insuredtype||', '||insuredoutputyear as insuredcolor, insuredoutputyear,
       insuredmark||'  '||  insuredmodel as insuredmodel, insuredstatenum, underframenum, insuredbannum,
       insuredenginenum,driveintended,numseats,extrafranshiz,im.franshiz,
       ins_pkg_motorkasco.getdraccesspeople(im.id) AS driveaccesspiople,
       ins_pkg_motorkasco.getAccessoriesName(ict.id) AS accessoriesname,
       im.drivecost as avtocost, im.inssumm,  
       to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate, 
	to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate2, 
       to_char(ict.ins_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') insdate,
       to_char(ict.end_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') enddate, 
       ict.policy_num policynum,ict.beneficiary,ict.conditions,
       theft,fire, explosion,trafficaccident, impactanyobject,
       im.ammount,ic.sex,
       val.valu_name valute,val.val_name , 
       ia.surname||' '||ia.name||' '||ia.fathername as agent, 
       ict.loanacc_id, ict.curracc_id
  FROM ins_contracts ict,
       ins_motorkasco im,      
       ins_mk_policy imp,
       ins_customers ic,
       avalute val,
       ins_agents ia
 WHERE 
ic.ID = ict.kli_id 
and ict.id = im.cid
and ict.id = imp.cid  
and ict.valute_id = val.valute(+)
and ict.agent_id = ia.id(+)
and ict.id = :CID
